items.summary: Created the first four-page Jev catalogue with an evidence-led report, comparison tables, and fit-check widget.
Recorded current launch-week use cases, alternatives, project evidence, access routes, and price uncertainty.
Added a plain-English What is Jev? ELI5 page while preserving the four required catalogue destinations.

Refreshed the official Jev model ID, aliases, endpoint, price, limits, context, text-only input, access ambiguity, and legal/data terms from current TypeSafe pages; no verified production-product finding was changed.
Separated current OpenRouter and Cloudflare listings from the inaccessible Vercel lead and the independent proxy, preserving the proxy's self-reported 10× higher price and remaining gaps.
Added the dated access, pricing, availability, and data-terms report for the regular run while retaining the bootstrap report and source trail.
